summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of new 'Historique des courses' feature (runner sessions + progression chart). Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass (10 new session tests + 8 regression). POST/GET/DELETE /api/sessions all working; 422 validation on empty names and empty performances; case-insensitive runner lookup; MongoDB _id excluded. Frontend web preview: all critical testIDs render and all requested flows pass end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844). Verified: 'Historique' pill (open-history-button) navigates to /history; full save flow (VMA 15 -> runner info -> 1000m 4:00 + 400m 1:30 -> save-session-button) shows inline 'Séance enregistrée dans l\'historique' (save-status-text) with save-status-history-link that navigates with firstName/lastName prefilled; saving without names shows red inline error (no crash, Alert.alert no-op on web as noted); adding/removing a race after save re-enables save button and clears save-status; History screen distance chips (distance-chip-400, distance-chip-1000), metric toggle (metric-speed, metric-time), progress-chart, best-value and progress-value all compute correctly for seeded 'Demo Coureur' (1000m speed: best=14.8 km/h, progress=+1.5 km/h green; 1000m time: best=4:04, progress=-0:26 green; 400m speed best=15.0 km/h); history-empty shown for unknown runner; history-back-button returns to home; delete flow (trash -> inline confirm -> confirm-delete-<id>) removes session card. Regression (VMA calculation, zones, race analysis, average) still works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: still uses deprecated datetime.utcnow() for VMACalculation.timestamp (ok, non-blocking) but new RunnerSession correctly uses datetime.now(timezone.utc). Good.

frontend/app/index.tsx is 1554 lines (above 700-line threshold). Consider splitting into components (VMAInputForm, RunnerInfo, PerformanceAnalysis, PerformancesList, SaveSessionSection, ExportView). Non-blocking.
history.tsx and ProgressChart.tsx are well-sized (<500 lines) and well-structured.
RunnerSessionCreate validates first/last via Field(min_length=1) producing 422 on empty strings — correct Pydantic v2 behavior.

GET /api/sessions correctly projects out _id ({"_id": 0}) and returns naive-UTC created_at (frontend history.tsx compensates by appending 'Z' when missing TZ) — safe but a tz-aware created_at would be cleaner.
seed_data_creation: Transient TEST_* sessions created and deleted during tests. Demo Coureur seed (4 sessions) remains intact (verified via GET).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has new session endpoints: POST/GET/DELETE /api/sessions. Validation: first_name/last_name min_length=1, performances min_length=1 => 422; vma_value gt=0 le=30. GET uses first_name & last_name query params, case-insensitive via runner_key (casefold). Session performances include zone_name (optional) + zone_index. Frontend testIDs: open-history-button, save-session-button, save-status-text, save-status-history-link, history-back-button, history-firstname-input, history-lastname-input, history-search-button, history-empty, distance-chip-<n>, metric-speed, metric-time, progress-chart, best-value, progress-value, session-card-<id>, delete-session-<id>, confirm-delete-<id>. Demo Coureur has 4 backdated sessions (1000m progressing 13.3->14.8 km/h, 400m constant 15 km/h). All flows and tests green.
